name: What are the signs that my bathroom ventilation is inadequate?

mainEntity.name: What are the signs that my bathroom ventilation is inadequate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs of inadequate bathroom ventilation include persistent foggy mirrors after a shower, peeling paint or wallpaper, visible mold or mildew on walls or ceilings, and a lingering musty odor. Excessive condensation on windows or cold surfaces, and prolonged dampness of towels or surfaces, also indicate a ventilation issue that needs addressing to prevent further damage and unhealthy conditions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs of poor ventilation include foggy mirrors, peeling paint, visible mold, lingering odors, and excessive condensation.
